summary: Comprehensive testing of JasprChain L1 blockchain new features: Slashing, P2P, and Move VM. All 81 backend API tests passed (100%). All three new features working correctly. Frontend loads and displays validators, staking with APY.

minor.issue: Returns 404 for validators not registered with slashing module. This is expected behavior - validators need to be registered first via record_block_signature()

passed_tests: - /api/slashing/stats returns slashing statistics (0 events initially as expected)
- /api/p2p/peers returns empty peer list (no real peers in simulation)
- /api/move/module/0x1::JASPR returns JASPR module with transfer, mint, burn functions
- /api/move/module/0x1::Coin returns Coin module with Coin, CoinStore structs
- /api/move/module/0x1::Account returns Account module with create_account function
- /api/move/deploy fails for duplicate modules (already exists error)
- Health endpoint returns chain_id=1, status=healthy, network=testnet
- Wallet creation returns MPC wallet with 10,000 JASPR
- Dashboard loads with JASPR branding, TESTNET badge
- Block height updates in real-time (661+ blocks)
- Validators page shows 4 validators with stake, voting power, performance
- Staking page shows validators with APY (9.04-9.57%)
critical_code_review_comments: Slashing module correctly implements double_sign (5%), downtime (0.1%), invalid_attestation (3%) penalties
P2P network uses gossip protocol with fanout=6, max_hops=4 for efficient message propagation
Move VM correctly initializes stdlib modules (JASPR, Coin, Account) at genesis
Move VM execute function properly validates module/function existence before execution
Gas metering implemented with GAS_UNIT_PRICE=100 nanoJASPR per gas unit
seed_data_creation: Test wallets and custom Move modules created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: JasprChain L1 blockchain now has three new major features: 1) Slashing - penalties for validator misbehavior (5% double sign, 0.1% downtime, 3% invalid attestation) 2) P2P - async networking with gossip protocol (simulation mode - is_running=false) 3) Move VM - smart contract execution with stdlib (JASPR, Coin, Account). All 81 backend tests pass. Key APIs: /api/slashing/stats, /api/p2p/info, /api/move/modules, /api/move/execute. Previous features (persistence, unbonding, staking) still work.
